date_note: Katadata (published 26 November) reports Mekari's 25 November statements; the page says unusual activity was detected on the morning of 25 November.
geo_basis: country as the source states it (Indonesia); no city given
title: Mekari says an external party attacked its systems; Talenta payroll and other apps disrupted
summary: Katadata reports that Mekari, the company behind Talenta, Qontak, Sign, Jurnal and Flex, said in a 25 November Instagram post that unusual activity was a cyberattack from an external party. Users complained of delayed salary payments. Bloomberg Technoz and CNBC Indonesia report Mekari disabled systems to prevent data movement; CNBC Indonesia says Mekari named malware as the source and said service was still not fully accessible on 26 November.
plain: Mekari, an Indonesian business software firm, says an outside party attacked its systems. Users reported late salary payments; CNBC Indonesia reports Mekari said service was still not fully accessible on 26 November.
exec: Mekari says it was hit by a cyberattack; users of Talenta reported late salary payments, per Katadata.
action: No action needed; for awareness. Mekari says it never asks for password, OTP codes or payroll data, or payments, via WhatsApp, phone or DM; payroll users were told to contact product support.

validation.note: Katadata and CNBC Indonesia (independent publishers) each report Mekari's own statements that systems were attacked/hit by malware and service was down; Bloomberg Technoz reports the disabling of systems. Mekari pages not read.

review.note: stronger than the source: plain/exec stated payroll delay as fact; Katadata says users reported late payments
